verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines are a fair axis for a system-on-chip, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a media engine or hardware encode/decode for AV1, HEVC or ProRes on M5. The battery-life figure for video streaming and the mention of running Final Cut Pro are adjacent claims, not codec hardware.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself
